name: Fort Witshire
title: Fort Witshire
summary: A fort built by a man named Witshire upon the ruins of an Empyrean fortress west of Cragstone, abandoned after the Tumeroks were driven back; Hollow Minions loyal to Martine have since barricaded it (Elysa's Favor). In the kit: a 72 m square fort on a raised plateau (z 90) - four 31 m spire towers at the corners (tops z 120.75), low curtain walls, a gatehouse on the east with a spiked wooden barricade, and Witshire's three-storey cottage-keep in the centre - with the slopes falling 15-20 m to the fields around.

shots.standingOrder: Fly due north straight over Witshire's cottage keep 42 m up, between the four spire towers, gimbal tracking the keep through vertical; stay 9 m above every spire tip.
shots.notes: Flagship pass-over: due north 42 m above the plateau (z 132, 11 m above the four spire tips at z 120.75) straight over Witshire's cottage-keep between the four corner spire towers, the gimbal tracking the keep through vertical (yaw-slew <= 45 deg/s): the square curtain walls, the barricaded east gate and the four towers wheel under the lens. Noon sun from the south. shots.standingOrder: Look up at the south-east spire tower from the grass outside the fort with the noon sun on its face; creep 1.5 m closer and keep 10 m from the stone.
